```{r fig-all-sems}
#| fig-asp: 1.618123
#| out-width: "66%"
#| fig-width: 6.6

# 100% and 10 for slide output

catch_assert <- assertthat::assert_that(
  "ggraph" %in% .packages(),
  msg = "Loading ggraph is required for SEM plots"
) # otherwise outputs TRUE

build_fig_all_sems(
  tar_read(
    spatial_sem_output,
    store = store_in_pipeline()
  ),
  sem_type = "nlme",
  label_variables = c(
    sd_r_average_log = "Variability",
    abs_trend_average_log = "Trend",
    HII_focal = "Hum. Imp.",
    mu_SR = "Richness",
    H_fine = "Land. Comp."
  ),
  selected_branch = 1,
  categories = c("farmland", "woodland", "built"),
  font_size = 12
)
```
